lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form V) imperfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ is in the derivative form: يَتَمَطَّى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
م/ط/و   m–ṭ–w to go fast; to open one’s eyes; limbs, to stretch one’s limbs; to swagger; back of an animal, to mount, riding animals. Of this root, يَتَمَطَّى yatamaṭṭā occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَتَمَطَّى yatamaṭṭā [imperf. of v. V تَمَطَّى tamaṭṭā, intrans.] to swagger, to strut

(75:33) ثُمَّ‏ ‏ذَهَبَ‏ ‏إِلَى‏ ‏أَهْلِهِ‏ ‏يَتَمَطَّى then he walked back to his people swaggering.
